mutations.name: cancelled-worker-event-before-cancellation-commit
mutations.change: Supply the Worker's Cancelled transition before the cancellation commit instead of after it.

mutations.name: late-success-uncancels-invocation
mutations.change: A late authenticated OperationSuccess observation also changes a Cancelled invocation to Succeeded and counts a successful delivery.
mutations.rejection: successful_result_deliveries: expected 0, observed 1; external_rollback_claimed: expected false, observed true; shell receipt or final retirement differs

method: Each mutation lived in an isolated detached worktree with its own target directory, was committed there only to satisfy the gate's clean-scope check, and made the same gate fail for the stated reason. The main worktree was not modified.
non_claims: These are causal gate rejections for two named guarantees, not exhaustive exploration of every shell race.
The late-success mutation deliberately changes production kernel observation semantics; it exists only in a throwaway worktree.
